t: This is the New Statesman, a British political and cultural magazine published in London. It began as a weekly review of politics and literature on 12 April 1913. Sidney Webb, the socialist economist who co-founded the London School of Economics, is named as its founder, and it was first connected with him and his wife Beatrice and other leading Fabians, including George Bernard Shaw, a founding director. Kingsley Martin edited it longest, from 1930 to 1960. Today the editor is Tom McTague, who took over in 2025.
